comment: C10 of RUNTIME-ACCEPTANCE-CONDITIONS.md (founder 2026-09-28): the direction for when the code decides and when an agent is called, as data the runtime reads. tier: code = a rule decides, no model in the loop; model = the session model answers in its own turn; agent = the code calls a model and waits. agent_when: the condition under which a code step escalates; null = never. never_agent: what an agent may never decide for this step. threshold: null until measured over 200 turns (section 4 of the conditions); while null the runtime logs confidence and calls no agent.

rules.raise_only: an agent answer may raise stringency (deeper, stricter, more review) and never lower it; a lowering answer is refused and the refusal is recorded (C8)
rules.unreachable: if the agent cannot be reached or times out, the code's own answer stands, marked unresolved; nothing is guessed (C9)
rules.recorded: every answer carries source (code|model|agent), confidence and one line of reason; the tier that answered is in the row (C7)
